english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for putting things into a container or filling it.
Use this for a physical container that holds or is filled with something.
Use this when a container or package has the capacity to contain something.

examples.english: I'll pack your clothes for you first.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 zong1 hou2 di1 saam1 sin1

examples.english: This bottle can contain hot water.
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 zeon1 zong1 zyu6 jit6 seoi2

examples.english: This bottle can hold two litres of water.
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 zeon1 zong1 dou2 loeng5 gung1 sing1 seoi2
